walk.environment: Build: the read-only worktree /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/tree at 9eb10528. I never edited it and ran no git write commands. The server ran from that folder through /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/L/launch.py, which drops the proxy variables, OO_DB_PASSPHRASE and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT, then execs the repo venv python with -c 'from src.api.main import main; main()'. Port 9609. Data dir: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/L/data, seeded FRESH (not copied), so there was no old-build briefing_cache. Seeding: scripts/ui_clickthrough_seed.py (default STATE C, 453 articles), then the row-L supplementary seed_extra.py, copied from /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/L-recheck, with the same passphrase and the server stopped. seed_extra adds synthetic World Bank figures (3 indicators, 44 countries including XKX, plus WB aggregates), 6 USGS rare-earth rows, index series, law revisions (GBR/EUU/FRA, one flagged large-removal) and Wikipedia-lane changes. Both steps ran with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE='walk-pass-2026' and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT unset. At rest: open_omniscience.db and wiki.db do not start with 'SQLite format 3', both after seeding and after the walk. Boot: neither variable set, no OO_NO_SCHEDULER, so boot engaged airplane mode. /api/system/lock-state read 'locked' at boot. I unlocked through the real #pw / #btn-unlock form, after which it read 'unlocked-encrypted' (res-smoke.json). A curl GET /api/system/network before unlock returned 503 'database is locked'; that was my own probe. Network: /api/system/network was online:false at boot, and I also POSTed {online:false}. I then POSTed /api/briefing/refresh (200) over loopback. online stayed false throughout, including after every consent Cancel. I opened the 'Load standard country data' consent popup (#net-consent) in en/fr/ar/zh, read it, screenshotted it (steps/shots/L11-consent-load-standard-{en,fr,ar,zh}.png) and cancelled it with 'Stay offline'. 'Go online' was never pressed. Across all 57 result files the browser recorded zero non-loopback requests. Browser: Playwright Chromium at /opt/pw-browsers/chromium, headless, args --disable-background-networking --disable-component-update --no-proxy-server. Viewports: 1440x950 in en/fr/ar/zh and 375x800 in en. Live switches used the top-bar #lang-switch / #lang-menu with no reload. Scratch: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/L (item scripts w_*.py, results *.json and res-*.json, shots/). The step scripts are in /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/L/steps (w_l1..w_l13, w_375, res-*.json, shots/), adapted from the re-walk's own scripts. Server stopped by PID 32172 (the wrapper shell 32170 first); port 9609 confirmed closed.
